def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    annual_dividend = 0.5
    dividend_growth_rate = 0.06
    required_rate_of_return = 0.10

    # Calculate the terminal value at the end of year 2
    year_3_dividend = annual_dividend * (1 + dividend_growth_rate)
    terminal_value = year_3_dividend / (
        required_rate_of_return - dividend_growth_rate
    )

    # Discount the dividends and terminal value to the present
    equity_value = (
        annual_dividend / (1 + required_rate_of_return)
        + (annual_dividend + terminal_value)
        / (1 + required_rate_of_return) ** 2
    )

    # return answer
    return round(equity_value, 3)
